title: Weapon Mounts
description: Empty steel cradles for the front-float guns. v0.31 water mounts are gunmetal with bright cyan tips (prop-water-mount, hi-vis, front-alt); float player-girl-front-water-still. v0.32 sling mounts are the same silhouette family with amber accents, not water cyan (prop-sling-mount, hi-vis, front-alt); float player-girl-front-sling-still. No gun or girl is baked in. Visual only. player-girl-tower-fire and player-girl-command are reused and are not part of this group.

source.note: Primary view=side, n_directions=1, name prop-water-mount-steel-cyan (object 5c81fc88). Replaces the wooden cradle. Hi-vis is a higher-cyan alternate of the same silhouette. Front alt is the dual-post steel U-cradle.

assets.description: Empty steel/gunmetal Y-fork with bright cyan cradle tips, 64×64. High contrast on the wooden barricade. Facing west-ish. No gun baked in.
assets.note: Primary mount. Replaces the wooden cradle (Tester Fail: wood-on-wood, 0 cyan). This steel version has ~20 cyan pixels and 0 brown. Origin feet (32, 60) ≈ (0.5, 0.9375). Attach player-girl-front-water-still at cradle pixel (32, 12), 48px above the feet. Brighter alternate: prop-water-mount-hi-vis.

assets.description: Brighter cyan alternate of the empty steel Y-fork, 64×64. Same silhouette as prop-water-mount with more cyan on the cradle and bands. No gun baked in.
assets.note: Optional high-contrast alternate (~67 cyan pixels, 0 brown). Swap in if prop-water-mount still reads faint on the wooden barricade. Same feet origin (32, 60) and cradle pixel (32, 12). Prefer the primary unless contrast QA asks for this.

assets.description: Dual-post steel water mount with a bright cyan U-cradle, 64×64. Empty; no gun baked in. Secondary to prop-water-mount.
assets.note: Front dual-post alt in the same steel+cyan family (replaces the wooden front post). Same feet origin (32, 60) and cradle height. Prefer prop-water-mount (side Y-fork) for the gun cradle.

assets.description: Empty steel Y-fork with amber cradle accents, 64×64. Facing west-ish. No gun baked in.
assets.note: v0.32 primary sling mount. Same silhouette family as prop-water-mount, amber instead of water cyan (~32 amber pixels). Origin feet (32, 60) ≈ (0.5, 0.9375). Attach player-girl-front-sling-still at cradle pixel (32, 12), 48px above the feet. Brighter alternate: prop-sling-mount-hi-vis. Reuse player-girl-tower-fire; do not bake the gun.

assets.description: Higher-amber alternate of the empty steel Y-fork, 64×64. Same silhouette as prop-sling-mount. No gun baked in.
assets.note: Optional high-contrast alternate (~135 amber pixels, 0 water cyan). Swap in if prop-sling-mount reads faint on the wooden barricade. Same feet origin (32, 60) and cradle pixel (32, 12). Prefer the primary unless contrast QA asks for this.

assets.description: Front dual-post steel sling mount with an amber U-cradle, 64×64. Empty; no gun baked in. Secondary to prop-sling-mount.
assets.note: Secondary front dual-post alt (~82 amber pixels). Same feet origin (32, 60) and cradle height. Prefer prop-sling-mount (side Y-fork) for the gun cradle.
